fusions.name: Pond Skipper
fusions.desc: Skims a hatchet that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then skips to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Unruffled Wake
fusions.desc: A full circle swing that throws up a wake, dealing 28 water damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Water off the Back
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: Rolls Right Off
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow that would have hit you is rolled a second time against your dodge, and the second roll stands.
